fusions.name: Lifted Purse
fusions.desc: Flicks a weighted pouch that deals 9 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Marked] for 6 seconds. It needs an affliction of yours on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Sleight of Cape
fusions.desc: Whips your cape wide, dealing 8 damage to up to 3 enemies within 3.5 tiles and turning them against each other for 4 seconds. Each is stunned for 0.8 seconds.

fusions.name: Turned Pockets
fusions.desc: Turns your pockets out: each debuff laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to its source instead, for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Pocketed Spoils
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you pocket 6 mana. Once every 6 seconds.
